question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**screening**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how BMI can be used as a tool for evaluating weight and health.
 
• The word should indicate the process of evaluating or assessing health in relation to body weight.
 
• "**Screening**" fits well as it refers to the examination or evaluation of something, particularly health-related assessments.
 
• Other options ("**planting**", "**landing**", "**hastening**") do not fit the context of health assessment.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We’re a society fixated on numbers. So, it’s no (1).* *surprise__* *we use measurements and equations to score our weight. The most (2).* *__popular__* *is BMI, a measure of our body weight to height ratio. BMI (3).* *__classifies__* *bodies as underweight, normal or healthy weight, overweight or obese and can be a useful tool for weight and health (4).* *__screening__* *. But it shouldn’t be used as the single (5).* **__________***of what it means to be a healthy weight when we set our weight loss goals.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Planting (रोपण): "Planting" refers to placing seeds or plants in the ground to grow, which does not fit the context of health assessment.
 
• Landing (अवतरण): "Landing" refers to bringing something to the ground or the act of arriving on the ground, which does not fit the context of health assessment.
 
• Hastening (त्वरित करना): "Hastening" refers to causing something to happen sooner than it otherwise would, which does not fit the context of health assessment.
